A '''labor-automata check point''' was the access point at a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] where a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] would enter the field. It was here that the automata would receive its orders for loading/offloading cargo, transportation assignments, refuelling, service duties, etc.
